speaker: jh
quote: We call it agentic AI. Agentic AI basically means that you have an AI that has agency. It can perceive, and understand the context of the circumstance. It can reason, very importantly, it can reason about how to answer, or how to solve a problem, and it can plan an action, it can plan, and take action.
quote_zh: 我們稱之為 agentic AI。意思是 AI 具有能動性：能感知並理解情境脈絡，能推理如何作答或解題，並能規劃、採取行動。（draft）
why_notable_zh: 本場對 agentic AI 的定義性表述

speaker: jh
quote: From retrieval based computing to generative based computing from the old way of doing data centers to a new way of building these infrastructure, and I call them AI factories. They're AI factories because it has one job, and one job only generating these incredible tokens
quote_zh: 從檢索式運算到生成式運算，從舊式資料中心到新型基礎設施——我稱之為 AI 工廠；因為它只有一件工作：產生這些了不起的 token。（draft）
